Right, I admit my estimate was totally incorrect.

Wow!
A total 180 degree turn in how promos are traditionally distributed in this game! With the exception of the first ever promo that came with a book, or rather coupon with which you could get that promo, and the subsequent planned one which never materialized, there has traditionally not been promos available only through purchase of something else (at least cards that weren't included in the actual sets or widely distributed promo kits and such).

This being said, I HOPE that this is just a marketing ploy to get cards out to potential future players to pique interest in this excellent game of ours. And as that the distribution method can be forgiven (since apparently you were supposed to get a coupon for Drivethru I think that the shipping costs outside USofA will again be rather steep...)

I actually haven't yet looked into this promotion/product yet, but I guess it is only temporay offer.

Which will put the future players/those who miss it now at disadvantage, but I kinda understood from a FB message that these cards might/will be in future BCP Bundle or somesuch. But for compleatists these have different set symbol.

I hope we won't have any of those "attendance promos for events" (Anthology was enough so that we could get the game back to print).

Messages.Author: PetriWessman
Messages.Body:
Ok, got the email with discount link for the printed cards (attached to the Humble Bundle).

Really hoping drivethrucards manages to figure out some form of EU-friendly shipping at some point -- since the shipping here is $15. It's a flat sum, seems to be the same at least for 1-3 packs, so if anyone (else) wants these it makes sense to order a bunch at the same time, at least if you're outside the U.S.

So for Finland, it came out to about $9 + $15 = $24 for 3 packs. That's 0,80 per card, which is not totally horrible -- but it's annoying that 2/3 of that cost is from shipping.

Oh well, it's very nice to be able to get print versions of these in any case
